166806425c.rewrite:
vmovq xmm0,QWORD PTR [rdi]
vptestmd k2,xmm0,xmm0
vpcmpeqd k1{k2},xmm0,XMMWORD PTR [rsi]
kmovd ecx,k1

166806425c.why: Fold the dead xmm1 load into the masked comparison. VMOVQ zeros xmm0 above bit 63, so k2 disables both upper dword lanes and the comparison accesses only bytes within the original eight-byte load.
